description: This file is an Angular service (`ApiService`) that manages API interactions, including user authentication, agent management, chat functionalities, preferences, and document uploads. It defines methods for making HTTP requests, handling authentication headers, and processing responses.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: An Angular service class providing methods for API endpoints related to authentication, agents, chat, preferences, and document management.

methods.name: authHeaders
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers with authorization token when available.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sends login request with email and password, returns authentication tokens.

methods.name: signup
methods.description: Sends signup request with email, password, and optional name, returns authentication tokens.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's profile information.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a chat message with specified payload.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Fetches messages for a specific chat session.

methods.name: updatePreference
methods.description: Updates a specific user preference key with a new value.

methods.name: uploadDocument
methods.description: Uploads a document for the system, handling FormData creation.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles HTTP errors and extracts error messages.
